name: AI Resume Analyzer - Python 3.11
updateContentCommand: if [ -f packages.txt ]; then sudo apt-get update && sudo xargs apt-get install -y < packages.txt; fi && if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip3 install --user -r requirements.txt; fi && pip3 install --user streamlit && echo '✅ AI Resume Analyzer - Packages and requirements installed successfully'
